findings.evidence: grep over TauCeti: `sum_of_regular_endpoints` occurs only at SturmSum.lean:71 (declaration) and SturmSum.lean:162 (`exact h.sum_of_regular_endpoints hsimple hcd hcZ hdZ`).
findings.fix: Mark it `private`; keep `Regular.sum` as the public form.
findings.issue: `Regular.sum_of_regular_endpoints` is public but strictly subsumed by `Regular.sum` (whose hypotheses `p.eval a ≠ 0`, `p.eval b ≠ 0` are weaker than `a, b ∉ zeros`, since `a ∈ zeros` follows from `p.eval a = 0` via `mem_zeros`), and it has exactly one use, at line 162 of the same file.

findings.evidence: SturmLocal.lean:79-83 signature has only `{p} {a r b}` plus `har hrb hr hd hz`; SturmSigns.lean:178-183 mentions only `Polynomial.eval`, `SignType.sign`, `Set.Icc`; IVT.lean:38 hosts `_root_.Polynomial.eval_mul_pos_of_no_roots`, its sole dependency.
findings.fix: Move both into the `Polynomial` namespace next to their dependencies (IVT.lean / PolynomialSigns.lean), e.g. `Polynomial.sign_eval_eq_of_forall_ne_zero` and `Polynomial.sign_eval_of_simple_root`, matching the repo's `_root_.Polynomial.*` convention in AbstractRolle.lean and this PR's own `Polynomial.sign_at_top`.
findings.issue: `Regular.root_signs` lives in `namespace Regular` but takes no `Regular` hypothesis: it is the general fact that `p` crosses a simple root from `-sign p'(r)` to `sign p'(r)`. `h.root_signs` dot-notation cannot work and the name advertises a chain property. Same problem for `TauCeti.Sturm.eval_sign_eq` (SturmSigns.lean:178), a general "constant sign on a root-free interval" lemma whose only dependency is `Polynomial.eval_mul_pos_of_no_roots`.

findings.evidence: SturmInfinity.lean:40-63: bodies are a `List.cons` induction whose only inputs are `sign_at_top p` / `sign_at_bot p` and `max`/`min`.
findings.fix: Move both to `PolynomialSigns.lean` as public `Polynomial.*` lemmas (a uniform bound beyond which every member of a list has its leading-coefficient sign); keep `exists_top`/`exists_bot` as the chain-level wrappers.
findings.issue: `signs_top` (line 40) and `signs_bot` (line 52) are `private`, but they are the list generalizations of `Polynomial.sign_at_top`/`sign_at_bot`: statements mention only Mathlib types and the proofs use nothing from the Sturm subject. Generality is a reason to relocate and export, not to hide.

findings.evidence: SturmTarski.lean:204 (`simp only [variation_eq, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.signVariations_singleton, ...]`) and SturmInfinity.lean:172, 183, 194 (`simpa [variation_eq, variationTop, variationBot] using hz`) unfold the definitions in `simp` rather than citing lemmas.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas `variation_nil`, `variation_singleton`, `variationTop_nil/_singleton`, `variationBot_nil/_singleton` (all `= 0`), and use them in place of the in-file unfoldings.
findings.issue: The three new counting definitions `variation` (SturmSigns.lean:82), `variationTop` and `variationBot` (SturmInfinity.lean:22, 26) have no degenerate-case lemmas. Bodies are unexposed, so a downstream consumer cannot even reduce `variation [p] x` or `variationTop [p]` without first rewriting with the `_eq` lemma; the PR itself works around this four times.

findings.evidence: SturmTarski.lean:204-205 closes the LHS with `List.signVariations_singleton, Nat.cast_zero, sub_self`; SturmInfinity.lean:171, 182, 193 call `tarski_zero` with `(a := a) (b := a)`, `(a := b) (b := b)`, `(a := 0) (b := 0)`.
findings.fix: Expose the content directly, e.g. `TarskiSeed.sum_sign_eq_zero (hseed : TarskiSeed p f 0) (hsimple) (Z) (hZ) : ∑ r ∈ Z, (SignType.sign (f.eval r) : ℤ) = 0`, and derive at most one variation-shaped corollary from it instead of three instantiations of `0 - 0`.
findings.issue: `tarski_zero` and its three corollaries `tarski_zero_Ioi/Iio/univ` (SturmInfinity.lean:165, 176, 187) state an identity whose left-hand side is identically `0`: `variation [p] a`, `variationTop [p]` and `variationBot [p]` are `signVariations` of one-element lists. In `tarski_zero` the endpoints `{a b}` are implicit and wholly unconstrained (not even `a < b`), so the real content — that the query sum vanishes — is only reachable by instantiating meaningless endpoints.

findings.evidence: Roadmap RealAlgebraicGeometry/README.md:213-215 requires infinite-endpoint versions and "The whole-line version computes `TaQ(q,p)`"; grep shows `variationTop`/`variationBot` appear only in SturmInfinity.lean, never together with `sturmSeq`.
findings.fix: Add `tarski_sturmSeq_univ` (and the half-line forms) plus `root_count_univ : (variationBot (sturmSeq p p.derivative) : ℤ) - variationTop (sturmSeq p p.derivative) = p.roots.toFinset.card`, mirroring the finite-interval pair.
findings.issue: The concrete-sequence API stops at finite intervals: `tarski_sturmSeq` (line 213) and `root_count` (line 232) have no `variationBot`/`variationTop` counterparts, although the abstract `tarski_Ioi/Iio/univ` exist. A consumer wanting the classical whole-field count must redo the `sturmSeq_cons` destructuring plus the `f * p.derivative = 0` case split that `tarski_sturmSeq` already performs.

summary: The chain-level API (`Signed`, `Regular`, `Remainder`, `TarskiSeed`) is well factored with hidden bodies and `_eq`/intro/elim lemmas, but the surface leaks a single-use helper, puts general real-closed polynomial-sign facts in Sturm-specific namespaces (one pair still `private`), lacks degenerate-case lemmas for the three new counting definitions, and exposes four theorems whose left-hand side is identically zero. The whole-line root count for `sturmSeq` — an explicit roadmap product — is not exposed.
